limitations: COMPILE_SOURCE is a corpus-local operation stimulus only. It is not a public input grammar, compiler API, runtime admission operation, or support claim.
CC-015 does not bind D07 or D10 and therefore creates no record-admission trace. Runtime admission inputs require separate authority and remain outside this workstream.
The retained variants encode inputs and intentional source deltas only. CC-015 owns no expected fact, canonical byte result, identity delta, artifact, diagnostic, decision, state digest, or outcome.

The neutral inputs remain unlisted in corpus.json and outside checksums.json. A later integration owner must review source and independent oracle candidates before publishing case membership and checksums.
CC-015 implements no compiler, resolver, adapter, runtime, public API, package, release, or CC-R stage.
